svg.aria-label: A leaf-spine data centre network: every leaf (top-of-rack) switch connects to every spine switch, so any two servers are at most leaf-spine-leaf apart, with many equal-cost paths that ECMP spreads traffic across. A border layer connects to the Internet.
svg.title: A leaf-spine data centre network: every leaf (top-of-rack) switch connects to every spine switch, so any two servers are at most leaf-spine-leaf apart, with many equal-cost paths that ECMP spreads traffic across. A border layer connects to the Internet.
svg.text: Any server → any server: leaf → spine → leaf. 4 equal-cost paths, spread by ECMP hashing.
